summary: Itasca County, MN: Chippewa National Forest steel tower surveyed 1959, removed 1972 (sale and removal dates conflict); footings reported at site as of 2023. No build year found.

facts.status_note: Removed in 1972 according to the A-Z list (May 1972); tower footings reported to remain at the site as of September 2023

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The A-Z list's height column reads 100 ft, while its own survey note and the 1959 station description give 110 ft overall. The record uses the 110 ft survey figure (33.5 m); 100 ft would be 30.5 m.
The A-Z list gives removal in May 1972, while the Forest Lookouts page says bids for the sale of the tower were opened on June 8, 1972. The sources do not reconcile these dates.

notes_for_editor: No source read gives a build year, so the story does not state one. An unopened Facebook group post (seen only as a search snippet) says the tower was used until 1976; it conflicts with the 1972 removal and was not used. The Minnesota Historical Society Forest History Center tower (built 1934, moved from Bena) is a different structure; do not conflate. A Star Tribune article on vanished Minnesota towers returned HTTP 429 and was not read.
